objective.text: Recognize an unsaved default related model returned by withDefault.

difficulty.rationale: Distinguish a presentation default from a persisted parent record.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: Article::writer() is a belongsTo relation with ->withDefault(["name" => "Guest"]). The article has writer_id=null. What describes $article->writer?

options.text: A Writer with name Guest and exists=false; reading it does not insert a writer.
options.rationale: withDefault supplies an unsaved related model for the absent relationship.

options.text: The first stored writer, with its name temporarily replaced by Guest.
options.rationale: The default is not an arbitrary existing row borrowed from the writers table.
options.misconception: The default is not an arbitrary existing row borrowed from the writers table.

options.text: A newly inserted Writer with a generated id and exists=true.
options.rationale: Property access does not automatically persist the default model.
options.misconception: Property access does not automatically persist the default model.

options.text: null, because withDefault only applies to empty strings.
options.rationale: The absent related model is precisely the supported default case.
options.misconception: The absent related model is precisely the supported default case.
